name: @pipeworx/mcp-permid

tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Search PermID for organizations, people, instruments, or quotes by name. Returns PermID, primary type, name, and a brief context. Use get_entity with the PermID for the full linked-data record.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Fetch the raw JSON-LD PermID record for a numeric PermID (e.g. "4295905573"). Returns the full linked-data payload from api-eit.refinitiv.com under the key "raw" — extract organization name, LEI, RIC, industry codes, and headquarters from the raw fields.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-permid forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the permid pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
